snippet.title: Corsair – Pirate Open World | Official Trailer | Sail, Fight & Plunder on Android
snippet.description:
Take the helm. Rule the sea.

Corsair – Pirate Open World is a first-person pirate adventure built for mobile. Sail an open sea, battle enemy ships, raid coastal forts and explore islands on foot. You can play it now, free, on Android.

DOWNLOAD FREE ON GOOGLE PLAY:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.saltwindgames.corsair

OPEN-WORLD SAILING
Take the wheel, trim your sails, read the wind and chart your own course across islands, ports and forts.

NAVAL COMBAT
Fire broadsides, man the deck cannons, board enemy ships and fight hand to hand with sword and pistol.

SEA MONSTERS
Face the Kraken and the Megalodon, if you dare.

EXPLORE ON FOOT
Walk harbour towns, dive beneath the waves and search sea caves and beaches for hidden treasure chests.

TRADE & UPGRADE
Trade cargo at market, hire a crew, then upgrade, repaint and customise your ship at the shipyard.

MORE TO DO
Missions, fishing, sea challenges, achievements and daily rewards.

BUILT FOR MOBILE
Touch controls designed for phones and tablets, with graphics presets for low-end through high-end devices.

The game is made by Saltwind Games, a solo indie studio, and gets regular updates. Feedback and ideas are always welcome!

https://www.saltwindgames.com
mickot0000@gmail.com

Soundcloud:   https://soundcloud.com/jetflystation/pirate-attack
